versions.changelog:
Initial release of commentmd: interactive Markdown commenting & review.

- Launches a browser-based UI for humans to select, comment, and submit feedback on any Markdown file.
- Generates a structured JSON containing comment context and details for agent processing.
- Handles both local and headless/remote workflows for flexible review.
- Detects and warns if the Markdown file changed during review.
- Enables agents to revise documents and summarize how each comment was addressed.
